schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Unique internal identifier for the obligor or corporate borrower.
reporting_instructions: Report primary obligor code assigned in loan origination system.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Synthetic 20-character obligor identifier; checksum not validated.
allowable_values: 20-character alphanumeric synthetic string; required in this demonstration.
reporting_instructions: Project assumption: require populated synthetic identifier.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Legal registered business name of the corporate borrower.
reporting_instructions: Report corporate name exactly as recorded in legal credit agreement.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Four-digit North American Industry Classification System code.
allowable_values: One of ten configured industry labels; classification not externally validated.
reporting_instructions: Reflect the primary line of business generating borrower cash flows.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Unique internal credit facility identifier assigned in loan accounting system.
reporting_instructions: Must remain constant across reporting quarters for tracking.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Type of loan credit facility committed by reporting institution.
allowable_values: Term Loan, Revolving Credit, Letter of Credit, Bridge Loan.
reporting_instructions: Classify based on credit agreement terms and liquidity structure.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Total legally committed credit exposure in reporting currency.
allowable_values: Positive numeric currency amount >= Drawn Balance.
reporting_instructions: Report total facility commitment including drawn and undrawn amounts.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Total utilized or drawn outstanding credit balance.
allowable_values: Non-negative numeric currency amount <= Committed Exposure.
reporting_instructions: Report outstanding principal balance net of charge-offs.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Ratio of utilized exposure to total committed credit facility.
reporting_instructions: Computed as Utilized Exposure divided by Committed Exposure.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Internal obligor credit risk rating grade on institutional 8-point scale.
reporting_instructions: Reflect current approved internal borrower risk rating.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Descriptive classification of internal credit rating grade.
allowable_values: Minimal Risk, Modest Risk, Average Risk, Acceptable Risk, Special Mention, Substandard, Doubtful, Loss.
reporting_instructions: Use the configured synthetic internal grade description.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Unique collateral record identifier linked to facility.
reporting_instructions: Foreign key linking facility to collateral management database.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Primary category of collateral securing credit facility.
allowable_values: Commercial Real Estate, Equipment and Machinery, Accounts Receivable and Inventory, Cash and Marketable Securities, Unsecured.
reporting_instructions: Select primary asset class pledged as perfected security interest.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Appraised current market valuation of pledged collateral assets.
allowable_values: Non-negative numeric amount. Zero for unsecured.
reporting_instructions: Report latest independent appraisal or marked collateral value.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Date on which credit facility agreement legally took effect.
allowable_values: Valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
reporting_instructions: Must precede or equal current reporting period date.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Current legal expiration or contractual maturity date of facility.
allowable_values: Valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format >= Origination Date.
reporting_instructions: Reflect legal maturity stated in operative credit amendment.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
business_definition: Effective annualized nominal interest rate or spread applied.
reporting_instructions: Reflect current all-in coupon rate applicable at quarter-end.

schedule_name: SYNTHETIC H.1-style subset; project item numbering
reporting_instructions: Denominate all reported exposures in base US Dollars.
